Name: NPC Location Compass
Author: Bouhm
Description:
[b]NPC Location Compass[/b] shows NPCs and players on-screen, with compass needles that show the direction and distance from the player's current position in the map.

[b][color=#6aa84f]For non-English players, translations are included in the base mod. [url=https://github.com/bouhm/stardew-valley-mods#translating-the-mods]Contributions are welcome[/url]![/color][/b]


[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
Hold the [b]ALT[/b] button (configurable) to show the compass needles:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NVRvPyW.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SWoutYZ.gif[/img]

To scroll through multiple characters indoors, right-click the compass needle.

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer ([b]must be installed by the host player[/b]).
[/list]
[*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
Notes:
[list]
[*]In multiplayer, it [b]must be installed by the host player too[/b].
[*]It only shows characters in the player's location by default.
[/list]

[b][size=5]Configure[/size][/b]
You can install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure the mod:
[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bouhm/stardew-valley-mods/main/LocationCompass/docs/images/config-menu.png[/img]
